recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-37451 application without changing approved behavior; FHIR-50266 can likely be closed by human review as already satisfied rather than treated as a separate AutoFHIR decision.
issue_request: FHIR-37451 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core R5 and requested language stating that _sort may use the :text modifier for reference and token search parameters, with examples _sort=code:text and _sort=-code:text.
initial_application: Commit a5f28ac2c00aed2da477f844c769d91bc5ad88a6 added the requested note to source/search.html but used _sort:-code:text for the descending example. Commit a3766ac36c61fa3448d53aca0519dcbd874cfc93 later updated conformance tagging in the same sentence and preserved the malformed example.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread records the product-name sorting use case behind the issue, and FHIR-I minutes for 2022-05-23 record the 8-0-0 persuasive vote. Later FHIR-50266 and its Zulip thread independently identify _sort:-code:text as a typo for _sort=-code:text, but FHIR-50266 is Triaged/Unresolved and was not separately decided in this default applied/published run. FHIR-37753 is a later conformance-summary cleanup already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Edited source/search.html, the authoritative FHIR-core search narrative page, so the negative example now matches the approved _sort syntax: _sort=-code:text.
source_changes: source/search.html: changed the _sort :text modifier example from _sort:-code:text to _sort=-code:text.
